newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's EDP surges in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's EDP surges in early trade.

text.p: Shares in utility EDP- Electricidade de Portugal surged 4.6 percent to 3,400 escudos in early trade on Lisbon bourse as investors boosted portfolios with shares they had not obtained in its privatisation.
"We're seeing both institutions and retail investors, from Portugal and abroad, vying for shares they didn't get in the privatisation," said one dealer, who asked not to be identified.
EDP shares stood at 3,400 escudos, up 151, in volume of 1,122,585 shares at 0857 GMT.
The government earned more than $2 billion from a more than 30 times oversubscribed privatisation of 30 percent of the capital of Portugal's dominant electricity provider on Monday.
